surface.name: Reading room
surface.body: The default view for an opened project. Three-pane shell with a top strip carrying view-toggle / refresh / entity count. List-and-detail navigation: pick an entity from the left catalog, read it in the center, click code anchors to open Monaco peeks on the right. The "specimen" mode — beautiful for reading one entity in depth.

region.name: Top strip
region.role: Cross-surface chrome: ← Lexicon back-link, project name (Fraunces, h3), project root (mono, vellum-3), then right-aligned view toggle (Reading / Graph), entity-count smallcap, and Refresh button.

region.name: Context sidebar
region.role: Left catalog. Hierarchical: System (+ cross-cutting terms/invariants) → Bounded contexts (each with terms / invariants / seams / boundary rules) → Decisions → Surfaces (each with regions). Active entry gets the `.active-rule` oxide rail. Surfaces drift flags (load issues) at the bottom under a top rule.

region.name: Entity detail
region.role: Center "specimen" column. 8-of-12-column body with smallcap kind label, h1 display-tight name, fqid in mono, then kind-specific prose (definition / statement+rationale / context-decision-consequences- alternatives for ADRs, etc.). Right 4-of-12 marginalia rail.

region.name: Marginalia rail
region.role: 4-column right rail inside the detail. Owner ref, validation mode, disambiguatesFrom, affects, supersedes / superseded-by, code anchors (each opens a peek), modules, source-file path. Calm; no headings, just smallcap labels.

region.name: Peek drawer
region.role: Right column, shown when peeks are open. Monaco editors with `lexicon-ink` theme; multiple peeks stack vertically. Drawer width persists via `usePersistedWidth`. Cross-surface — shared with the graph view through `PeekProvider`.
